t.zh: 自动证明器在一堆句子里找矛盾，却多半不会归纳；化简器能改写，可「1 + 1 = 2」怎么证？数从哪里来？这一章从头构造数和列表，规则书里的每一条都由你声明。
t.en: An automatic prover hunts for a contradiction among sentences, yet mostly cannot do induction; Simp rewrites, but how is “1 + 1 = 2” proved? Where do numbers come from? This chapter builds numbers and lists from the start, and you declare every rule in the book.

t.zh: 数也靠声明。这一次声明的是一种东西，它的引入规则叫<wiki-ref to="constructor"></wiki-ref>：每条造出一个数。
t.en: Numbers too come from a declaration. This time what is declared is a kind of thing, and its introduction rules are called <wiki-ref to="constructor"></wiki-ref>s: each makes a number.

after.zh: 这样声明出来的类型叫<wiki-ref to="inductive"></wiki-ref>。证明核由它生成三样规则：按情况分、归纳、构造子互不相同。
after.en: A type declared this way is an <wiki-ref to="inductive"></wiki-ref>. The kernel makes three kinds of rule from it: cases, induction, and the constructors all being different.

brief.zh: 需求：什么都没有，也造得出一个自然数（0）；有了一个数，就造得出它的下一个。写出自然数的声明。
brief.en: Requirement: a number can be made from nothing (0); given a number, the next one can be made. Write the declaration of the numbers.

hint.en: The requirement names two ways to make one.

hint.zh: 第二种造法要的前提，正是一个数。
hint.en: The premise of the second way is a number itself.
